_note: Locks the empty-cohort / zero-denominator code path. Patients exist (p1/p2/p3 born 1980-1990, ages 36-46 at 2026-06-30) so PatientDiscoveryService finds them and evaluation runs, but IP criteria `AgeInYearsAt(end of MP) >= 200` rejects all → IP=0. Catches regressions where empty cohort produces NaN, 0.0, or a 5xx — all of which would silently corrupt dashboard aggregations downstream.
